Four family members found dead in Uttar Pradesh home

Four members of a family were found dead in their home in Balrampur, Uttar Pradesh, on Friday evening around 6:50 PM. Initial reports suggest a man shot his wife and two children before taking his own life. The scene reportedly shocked onlookers.
